# IntelliPandora

> A verdict layer on top of pytest for HTTP, Web (Playwright), concurrency and image checks. pytest answers "did any test fail"; IntelliPandora answers "can this pass be trusted": what each case actually judged, which cases judged nothing, and whether the suite judges less than its committed baseline. Deterministic: no LLM takes part in a verdict.

Documentation is Markdown in the repository and is the single source. The reference pages are generated from the code.

## Start here

- [Quick start](docs/guide/quickstart.md): install, `ipandora init`, first run, accept the judgement baseline
- [Why not plain pytest](docs/guide/why.md): what pytest and its plugins already do, and what this adds
- [AGENTS.md template for test projects](src/ipandora/templates/project/AGENTS.md): rules for agents writing tests, each tied to a gate or a report signal

## Guide

- [Judgements, unverified cases and the baseline](docs/guide/judgements.md): assert_all, field(), that(), require(), eventually(), conf/judgements.json, --fail-on-weakened
- [HTTP](docs/guide/http.md): API classes, responses, timeouts, retries, TLS
- [Organising a case library](docs/guide/layout.md): `ipandora init --layout full`, apis/ flows/ pages/ data/ tests/, judgements only in tests/, pytest.ini pythonpath, data-driven cases with cases('data/x.yaml'), `ipandora check layout`
- [Login state](docs/guide/auth.md): auth.identity('buyer'), auth.provider(...), Bearer / ApiKey / Cookies, early refresh, one replay after a 401, anonymous
- [Parallel and concurrent](docs/guide/parallel.md): --workers, @pytest.mark.resource, --timeout, concurrently()
- [Web](docs/guide/web.md): Playwright as is; expect() as judgements; stale selector vs missing element
- [Images](docs/guide/visual.md): matches_golden(), what pixel comparison can and cannot see
- [Configuration](docs/guide/config.md): conf/, per-environment overlays, Runtime
- [Reports and triage](docs/guide/reports.md): HTML/JSON/JUnit, failure categories, calling run() from Python
- [CI](docs/guide/ci.md): exit codes, --fail-on-weakened, baseline review, sharding and `ipandora merge`, browsers and goldens in CI
- [Agents](docs/guide/agents.md): MCP tools run_tests / explain_failure / list_runs / build_report
- [Evaluating agents](docs/guide/eval.md): datasets with a content hash, k trials per task, Wilson interval, pass@k / pass^k, paired comparison with the baseline, reference self-check, human labelling; multi-turn business agents with a scripted user and end-state / tool-call checks (`dialogue`); agent safety by planted canaries, injections, decoys and an egress allowlist (`safety`); Inspect logs read into the same run (`ipandora eval inspect`) and graders as Inspect scorers
